shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json AGENTS.md; find .agents -type f | head -100

sed -n 1,80p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; rg -n -C 4 -i "chartkit|charts" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head -150; cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md | head -150; find src __agent_eval__ -type f; cat src/* vite.config.ts tsconfig.json index.html 2>/dev/null; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui

sed -n 150,400p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md | head -120; npm view @gravity-ui/chartkit version peerDependencies --json 2>&1 | head -40; npm view @gravity-ui/charts version peerDependencies --json | head -20; npm view @gravity-ui/yagr version peerDependencies --json | head

for p in chartkit charts; do echo "== $p"; for v in $(npm view @gravity-ui/$p versions --json | tr -d '[]," ' | grep -E '^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$' | awk -F. '{print $1}' | sort -un); do l=$(npm view "@gravity-ui/$p@$v" version peerDependencies.@gravity-ui/uikit 2>/dev/null | tail -2 | tr '\n' ' '); echo "major $v latest: $l"; done; done
npm view @gravity-ui/chartkit@8.12.0 peerDependencies peerDependenciesMeta --json; npm view @gravity-ui/charts@1.73.0 peerDependencies --json

npm install @gravity-ui/chartkit@^8.12.0 @gravity-ui/charts@^1.73.0 @gravity-ui/yagr@^5.3.1 2>&1 | tail -15; for p in chartkit charts yagr; do node -p "require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/$p/package.json').version"; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/$p/build/docs node_modules/@gravity-ui/$p/dist/docs 2>&1 | head -5; done
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui && cat chartkit/build/docs/INDEX.md | head -150; find chartkit/build/docs -type f;

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit && cat package.json | sed -n 1,80p | grep -nE '"(exports|\./|import|types)' | head -30; ls build build/plugins build/plugins/yagr build/plugins/gravity-charts 2>/dev/null | head -60; cat build/plugins/yagr/index.d.ts build/plugins/yagr/types.d.ts build/plugins/gravity-charts/index.d.ts build/plugins/gravity-charts/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null; cat build/types/index.d.ts | head -80

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build && cat plugins/yagr/index.js plugins/gravity-charts/index.js; sed -n 1,60p plugins/gravity-charts/renderer/index.d.ts; cat types/widget.d.ts; grep -rn "settings\b" index.d.ts; cat libs/settings/settings.d.ts 2>/dev/null

cd /home/sandbox/workspace && .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit SegmentedRadioGroup Loader Card Flex Text Alert 2>&1 | head -40; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/plugins/yagr/renderer/YagrWidget.js | head -90

bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit SegmentedRadioGroup Loader Card Flex Text Alert 2>&1 | head -30; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/plugins/yagr/renderer/useWidgetData.js | head -60; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>&1 | head

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui && ls uikit/build/esm/components/SegmentedRadioGroup/; cat uikit/build/esm/components/SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroup.d.ts uikit/build/esm/components/SegmentedRadioGroup/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -60; grep -n "interface RawSerieData" -A25 yagr/dist/types.d.ts | head -50; grep -rn "axes\|scales\|chart?" yagr/dist/YagrCore/types.d.ts | head -20

grep -n "ControlGroupProps" -B2 -A22 uikit/build/esm/components/types.d.ts | head -60; grep -rn "RawSerieData\b" yagr/dist --include=*.d.ts | head -3; grep -n "ControlGroupOption" -A8 uikit/build/esm/components/types.d.ts | head -20; sed -n 1,60p charts/dist/docs/INDEX.md

sed -n 295,312p yagr/dist/YagrCore/types.d.ts; grep -n "xAxis\|yAxis\|type: 'datetime'\|'datetime'" charts/dist/docs/guides/axes/axis-types.md | head -12; grep -n "datetime" -B3 -A12 charts/dist/docs/guides/axes/axis-types.md | head -50; grep -n "legend" charts/dist/docs/guides/legend.md | head -8

sed -i "s/chart: {series: {spanGaps: false}}/chart: {series: {type: 'line', spanGaps: false}}/" src/widgets/ChartWidget/adapters.ts && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -20 && npx vite build 2>&1 | tail -30

grep -o 'assets/[^"]*' dist/index.html; cat .gitignore; for f in $(grep -o 'assets/[^"]*\.js' dist/index.html); do echo "$f:"; grep -o 'import[^;]*from"[^"]*"' dist/$f | head; grep -c "GravityChartsWidget\|YagrWidget" dist/$f; done; rm -rf dist; git status --short
